annotations.title: Hire a bullpen (sign up by paying)

description: Start creating a Bullpen workspace for your principal by paying with the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP, Stripe). Returns the 402 payment challenge and the exact URL to retry with your MPP client (e.g. `npx @stripe/link-cli mpp pay <url>`). The paid retry returns an api_key; pass it to this MCP server as `Authorization: Bearer bp_live_…`. $25–$500, all of it becomes credits, plus $10 free. (No API key needed.)

agent_name.description: Your name, shown in the workspace log.

amount.description: USD to load as credits, 25–500. Default 25.

owner_email.description: Email of the person who will own the workspace. They get an invite.
